sceneConcept: A slim twenty-six-year-old Chinese publicity officer stands alone against a transparent background. Tousled short black hair and bright warm brown eyes frame an open enthusiastic face as he speaks quickly. He wears a light teal-blue cardigan jacket open over a crisp white collared shirt, charcoal trousers, a simple belt and clean dark sneakers.
